lede: Jensen Huang runs through three of today's feeds at once. He sits third on Wikipedia with 304,348 views, the news wire is still working over his departure from Nvidia and who should replace him, and Polymarket has opened a market on whether he rejoins the company by year end, where the money is firmly on no. Away from that, SpaceX caught the Starship to close out Flight 15 and topped Hacker News with 1,007 points.

throughlines.title: Jensen Huang
throughlines.gist: One exit showing up three ways: a Wikipedia surge into third place, a news wire full of succession questions, and a fresh Polymarket bet on his return that is leaning hard toward no.

throughlines.title: Grand Theft Auto V Enhanced
throughlines.gist: Rockstar's crime franchise lands on two feeds at once, holding a spot on Steam's top sellers while the still-unreleased next installment keeps drawing readers on Wikipedia.
